sense: text or a picture, of an AI

terms.gloss: to form, to fashion, to make up; here, to generate
evidence: Cic. Ac. 2.87: esse aliquam vim, quae fīnxerit … hominem (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically to shape or fashion (of a potter, a sculptor, a bird building its nest), and to imagine or make up (see create, imagine). Both senses meet in what an AI does with a picture or a text; the use is modern, and ours. A picture so made is an imāgō ficta, or ā māchinā ficta to say who made it.

phrases.english: The AI made up a picture of a dragon.

phrases.latin: Utrum homo hoc pīnxit an māchina?
phrases.english: Did a person draw this, or a machine?
a picture generated by a machine

sources: Lewis & Short: fingo
